messages:
Alex M: morning async — GPU ops handoff (what I did / blockers / today)

Alex M: Did: rolled out the AZ-fallback flow for us-west-2 (drain -> evict -> fallback to smaller model), smoke-tested on canary.
Alex M: Blocker: seeing intermittent preemptions in us-east-1 that are killing long seq jobs; need better retry/backoff or submit-job guard.
Alex M: Today: open PR for retry/backoff + follow up with cloud partner for preemption patterns and quota bump for p4d in eu-west-1.

Priya K: Did: added queue-depth histogram to the autoscaler metrics and a short-lived alert for sustained queue>200.
Priya K: Blocker: billing needs to approve vCPU burst for the dedicated test cluster (stuck on approvals).
Priya K: Today: will run the histogram against staging traffic and tweak scaling thresholds.

Omar: Did: provisioned 4x A100 nodes in eu-west-1 for Dedicated pools (manual for now).
Omar: Blocker: console shows quota=0 for p4d in us-west-2, submitted support case.
Omar: Today: will follow up with cloud support and try a different AZ if quota not returned.

Dana S: Did: updated node preemption runbook (added new checklist and rollback steps).
Dana S: Blocker: need product decision on acceptable SLAs when falling back to smaller models under capacity pressure.
Dana S: Today: will sync with product and update runbook if we get clarity.

infra-bot: deploy: models/runtime v2.14 deployed to staged GPUs — 5% traffic.

Alex M: ping @Priya K on autoscaler PR review — it only changes the histogram naming and one threshold. :eyes:
Alex M: @Omar can you paste the cloud case link and the CSV you attached? helps the quota request.

Priya K: ack — reviewing now, left one inline comment about the alert window.

Omar: Case: https://cloud.vendor/support/cases/12345 — they asked for monthly usage csv, attached in the case. Estimate ~24h for quota sync.

Dana S: noted a small latency spike for >2048 token sequences on the canary nodes — looks like kernel fallback on one build. Filed tracking issue #987.

Alex M: thanks. If quota comes through, I'll start the dedicated canary at 13:00 PST and run 1hr soak. If still blocked, we'll fallback to smaller models + enable prefix cache on the critical routes.

Priya K: prefix cache in staging reduced token count ~15% on chat flows, so fallback path should be acceptable short-term.

Alex M: cool. No other blockers from me. Will update thread after cloud reply. :thumbsup:
